span.p:
After each close, on spark1:
market_daily --refresh --brief-book --paper-trade

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Refresh the layers the desk reads
bars · EDGAR events and facts · release exhibits

div.style: color: rgb(24, 59, 27) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
As-of parquet store
bars, filings, release text, tone

div.style: color: rgb(46, 36, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Release reader
DeepSeek V4 Flash: five fields per release
outlook · demand · pricing · capex · supply

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Panel of the book
93 AI-infra and software names,
benchmark, themes

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Four analysts + rotation
fundamental · technical · sentiment · value
each a rank across the book that session

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Regime
participation percentile, exposure,
tightening flag

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Grade
equal-weight sum of convictions,
A+ · A · B · C, participation gates

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
risk.desk_targets - the one allocation
engine weights → grade × exposure
→ tightening tilt → name and theme caps last

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Plan, persisted before anything is sent
shares sized at the close,
one client order id per name and side

div.style: color: rgb(74, 44, 10) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Next session: reconcile by order id
settle fills, roll the clock back
on anything unfilled

div.style: color: rgb(16, 42, 67) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The day's record
grades, targets, fills, and for each name
a plain-English reason chosen by unusualness

div.style: color: rgb(46, 36, 80) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(24, 59, 27) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Desk records
one file per session, never pruned

div.style: color: rgb(29, 29, 31) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Desk view
one person only: MARKET_DESK_USER

div.style: color: rgb(77, 57, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
The model decides nothing numeric.
Tone fields and prose are its;
every rank, grade and weight is a rule,
measured walk-forward before it was kept

div.style: color: rgb(77, 57, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
No exit analyst: every exit trigger
tested sold into a rise.
The rebalance is the exit
